events.event: Coordinating Minister Yusril Ihza Mahendra, after being summoned to the Istana, says President Prabowo asked for a deeper study of the corruption definition to align the Tipikor laws with UNCAC while stating that the state-loss element 'must not be forgotten'.
events.key_numbers: Law 31/1999 and Law 20/2001 to be aligned with UNCAC (ratified 2006) · study team of law enforcers, academics and activists proposed, incl. Romli Atmasasmita · under-invoicing example: 20,000 t exported vs 10,000 t reported · meeting with DEN the same afternoon
events.why_it_matters: First account relayed from the Istana side after Luhut's claim: state loss stays, but the scope is to be widened (Yusril's account, not a Palace statement).
events.spreading_evidence: Top of CNN Indonesia nasional list 26 Oct evening (two items); Kompas, Kontan, Kumparan, Liputan6 all carried it

events.event: KPK spokesperson Budi Prasetyo says KPK will summon ATR/BPN Minister Nusron Wahid again 'secepatnya' as a witness in the HGB bribery and gratuity case, after he skipped two summonses; MAKI separately reported KPK leadership to the KPK Dewas.
events.key_numbers: 8 suspects named · summons skipped 7 Oct (ministry agenda) and 15 Oct (abroad, Singapore/Malaysia per CNN) · 4 of the suspects described by KPK as Nusron's trusted aides · initial detention 15 Sep-4 Oct 2026
events.why_it_matters: A sitting minister has twice not shown up for KPK questioning while people around him are suspects; no date is set for the new summons.

events.event: DPR Commission III forms a Panja for the Asset Forfeiture Bill (RUU Perampasan Aset) chaired by Habiburokhman, and moves public hearings forward into the recess, aiming to pass the bill by 15 December 2026.
events.key_numbers: Target: enacted by 15 Dec 2026 · Panja chair Habiburokhman, deputy Soedeson Tandra (Golkar) · ~20 civil-society groups to be heard in stages · DPR recess 9 Oct-9 Nov
events.why_it_matters: A bill long stalled in the DPR is now on a fixed schedule, alongside the debate over how corruption is defined.

events.event: Two sons of Haji and Umrah Minister Mochamad Irfan Yusuf (Gus Irfan) resign as expert staff at the ministry after public criticism of nepotism; Deputy Minister Dahnil Anzar Simanjuntak confirms receipt of the letters.
events.key_numbers: 2 resignations (Barbarossa Muhammad Farros, Gibran Muhammad Fawwaz) · helped unpaid from BP Haji's formation in late Oct 2024 per Dahnil · vacancies to be refilled
events.why_it_matters: Public pressure over a minister appointing family members led to a quick reversal.

events.event: President Prabowo summons Home Minister Tito Karnavian and BMKG head Teuku Faisal Fathani to the Istana to discuss karhutla, the El Nino outlook and hydrometeorological disaster preparedness.
events.key_numbers: Rainy season about 20-30 days late due to El Nino · some areas get rain Nov-Dec, peak Dec-Feb · high cloud-growth potential in Central Kalimantan (next 5 days) and South Sumatra · cloud seeding with dry ice and NaCl on the President's instruction
events.why_it_matters: Signals that the government expects fires to last until the rains arrive; outcome of the closed meeting not yet reported.

events.event: Menkum Supratman asks the Ditjen Peraturan Perundang-undangan to study the consequences of the MK ruling ordering the Military Courts Law (UU 31/1997) to be amended within two years; PDI-P (Hasto) had backed the revision on 25 Oct.
events.key_numbers: MK case 260/PUU-XXIII/2025 (cited as /2026 by ANTARA), ruling 15 Oct 2026 · amendment deadline: 2 years · ordinary crimes by soldiers to go to civilian courts
events.why_it_matters: The government's first formal step after the MK ruling that soldiers' ordinary crimes belong in civilian courts.
events.spreading_evidence: ANTARA Hukum list 27 Oct (3 hours old at fetch)
